# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Ankiel Code or Ankiel-operated infrastructure to
[security@code.ankiel.com](mailto:security@code.ankiel.com). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://code.ankiel.com/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
